evidence.quote: International students are students who are not citizens of a member state of the European Union or another signatory state to the Agreement on the European Economic Area.
Tuition fees for international students at universities in Baden-Württemberg are 1,500.00 EUR per semester.

notes: The application deadline is given as "28. April - 15. Juli" on the programme page but the year is not stated for a non-EU applicant, and the DAAD page says "This programme has no deadline listed", so no intake could be recorded. The tuition fee is a state-wide figure for international students at Baden-Württemberg universities, stated on the university's central fees page but not on the programme's own page; possible exemptions exist (Landeshochschulgebührengesetz). No document list for international applicants was found on the supplied pages.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT Home Edition (before 2026): 79 IELTS Academic: 6 Cambridge English Qualifications: B2 First
As courses and examinations in this degree program are held in English, you must have a good command of English at B2 level.

note.en: Foreign school-leaving qualification must be recognized by the Studienkolleg Konstanz; check the recognition procedure.

note.fr: Si vous êtes déjà étudiant(e), la reconnaissance des acquis peut donner accès à un semestre supérieur ; sinon, postulez au 1er semestre.
note.en: If you have prior studies, credit recognition may allow entry to a higher semester; otherwise, apply for the first semester.
